title: Fitting Every Hint Is Not Enough: Premature Floods in Recurrent Algorithmic Reasoners
abstract: arXiv:2610.14982v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recurrent algorithmic reasoners are trained with per-step hints on small graphs and run for many more steps on large ones. On breadth-first search in SALSA-CLRS, we find that a reasoner can reproduce every training hint and still fail on deep graphs: after some exact steps, it declares nodes reached before the search gets there. We call this a premature flood and trace two routes to it. In our GRU processor with a degree input, the flood is carried in the hidden state and set off when that input is in the tail of the training distribution. Setting the input higher at inference brings the flood sooner, and none of the six flooding models counts steps. Without the input, summing the neighbors' states instead of averaging them also breaks the processor. In the benchmark's own GIN and PGN, trained with its code, some seeds instead flood from a fixed step, on sparse and dense graphs alike. Clamping the degree input or adding 200 dense train

translated_title: 拟合所有提示还不够：循环算法推理器中的过早泛洪
translated_abstract: 循环算法推理器在小图上通过逐步提示进行训练，然后在大图上运行多得多的步数。在SALSA-CLRS基准的广度优先搜索任务中，我们发现推理器即使能够重现每一个训练提示，在深层图上仍会失败：在若干精确步骤之后，它会在搜索尚未到达某些节点之前就宣布这些节点已被到达。我们将这一现象称为“过早泛洪”，并追溯了导致它的两条路径。在我们带度数输入的GRU处理器中，泛洪由隐藏状态携带传播，当该输入处于训练分布的尾部时被触发；在推理时将此输入设置得更高会使泛洪更早出现，而六个发生泛洪的模型中没有一个是在计数步骤。在移除该输入的情况下，用求和而非平均来聚合邻居状态同样会破坏处理器。在基准测试自带的GIN和PGN模型（使用其官方代码训练）中，部分随机种子则会从某个固定步骤开始泛洪，且无论稀疏图还是稠密图均如此。对度数输入进行钳制或添加200个稠密训练样本（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 循环算法推理器即使能完美重现所有训练提示，在大图上仍会发生“过早泛洪”——在广度优先搜索到达之前就提前宣布节点已被访问，其根源在于度数输入偏离训练分布并由隐藏状态携带触发，或从固定步骤开始泛洪这两条路径。
en_tdlr: Recurrent algorithmic reasoners can perfectly reproduce every training hint yet still suffer "premature floods" on larger graphs—declaring BFS nodes reached before the search arrives—triggered either by degree inputs in the tail of the training distribution carried in the hidden state, or from a fixed step.
